For the Sealing & Polymer department, we are looking for an enthusiastic Prep & Finish Operator. You will join a dynamic team where quality, precision, and collaboration are key. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that products are carefully prepared and finished, meeting the highest quality standards.

You work accurately according to established quality guidelines and, together with your colleagues, ensure that every product is delivered in perfect condition.

In addition, you work carefully, have technical insight, and have a good command of the Dutch and/or English language.
